title: Perlawanan Persahabatan: Buluh FC vs Hulubalang United (3–0)
notes: Source of truth for Episode 3 TTS, timed bilingual subtitles, goal/HUD/shake/slow-motion cues and SFX. Casual spoken Malay with a smaller English translation line. No CTAs. Frame 0 opens at full brightness with active motion; first cut by frame 45. Ends on the captain's line, a referee whistle and a hard cut to the black BULOH FC / EPISOD 3 title card.

scenes.name: Cold Open Hook — Goal 1 (1–0)
scenes.environment: StadiumApp (tight low-angle near the Hulubalang goal)
scenes.visual: Frame 0 at full brightness: tight low-angle mid-strike, ball rockets past the keeper into the net. Major angle cut at frame 45. HookTitle spring-pops for frames 0–45.

hook.title: RAMAI INGAT BULUH FC KENA BELASAH...

scenes.sfx: Frame-0 sharp leather kick + bass transient; net ripple at frame 26; small crowd burst at frame 30.
scenes.bgm: Punchy, low-energy underscore starts under the voice, ducked.

events.note: Keeper dive angle — first major shift, must land by frame 60.

lines.text: Gol! Sekali tendang, Buluh FC dah buka skor.
lines.translation: Goal! One strike and Buluh FC are on the board.

scenes.name: Stakes + Goal 2 — Teamwork (2–0)
scenes.visual: Four snappy cuts: crisp 1–2 pass splitting two Hulubalang defenders, close-range finish, keeper beaten, net ripple. Broadcast scoreboard flips to 2–0.
scenes.sfx: Ball whoosh at frame 280; net ripple and a medium crowd cheer at frame 294.
scenes.bgm: Underscore rises a step; ducked under the RIZAL line.

lines.text: Hulubalang United favourite... tapi Buluh FC main lain macam hari ni.
lines.translation: Hulubalang United were the favourites... but Buluh FC are a different team today.

lines.speaker: RIZAL
lines.text: Satu-dua, terus tembus! Kita tak main-main!
lines.translation: One-two, straight through! We're not messing around!
Two goals. The stadium starts to believe.

scenes.name: Goal 3 — The Banger / Hero Moment (3–0)
scenes.environment: StadiumApp (low-angle hero strike -> top-corner ball tracking)
scenes.visual: Wind-up, 0.3x slow-motion dip on foot-to-ball contact at frame 81, 5-frame camera shake, glowing ball trail tracking into the top corner, net ripple. HUD flips to 3–0.
scenes.sfx: Whoosh at frame 70; frame-81 kick impact + bass hit; net ripple at frame 84; biggest crowd cheer at frame 81.
scenes.bgm: Underscore peaks at the strike, then holds under the reactions.

lines.text: Gol ketiga. Satu banger dari luar kotak.
lines.translation: Goal three. A banger from outside the box.

lines.speaker: RIZAL
lines.translation: Bro! That shot was a rocket!

scenes.name: Fans Start Believing
scenes.environment: StadiumApp (near touchline, KEK MAJU ad-board, instanced crowd silhouettes)
scenes.visual: Touchline cut: the Kek Maju bakery owner from Ep. 2 smiles proudly with 2–3 local fans; a lightweight InstancedMesh crowd jumps on a procedural sine wave. The sideline ad-board clearly shows KEK MAJU.
scenes.sfx: Big crowd cheer at frame 12; second cheer at frame 216.
scenes.bgm: Warm, hopeful swell under the fan dialogue.

lines.speaker: PEMINAT
lines.text: Lain macam... musim ni Buluh FC memang serius!
lines.translation: Different vibe... Buluh FC are serious this season!

lines.text: Dari kedai kek sampai ke tepi padang. Akak pun percaya.
lines.translation: From the bakery to the touchline. Even Kak believes.

scenes.name: Cliffhanger — Ready for Season Start
scenes.environment: StadiumApp (golden-hour / floodlight huddle, slow heroic push-in)
scenes.visual: Golden-hour floodlight lighting; Buluh FC line up and huddle on the pitch with a slow heroic push-in on the captain. Referee whistle and deep BGM hit, then a hard cut to black.
scenes.sfx: Referee whistle at frame 114; deep bass/BGM hit at frame 114.
scenes.bgm: Triumphant BGM swell into the cut; nothing under the title card.

events.note: Cut to black title card at absolute frame 1188.

lines.speaker: KAPTEEN
lines.text: Pemanas badan dah habis. Musim baru bermula.
lines.translation: The warm-up is over. The new season begins.

scenes.name: Outro Title Card
scenes.visual: Hard cut to clean black card: BULOH FC / thin gold divider / EPISOD 3. No CTA.
